reading_of_a_layer: On the rows read of each month: change = 100 x (RMSE(on) / RMSE(off) - 1); interval = run_intruder_bound.interval (paired days, 2,000 replicates); per layer one generator numpy.random.default_rng(20261004) drawn over the months in calendar order (February, then June), as tools/run_febjun_check.py; switch-off if change > 0 and the interval's lower end > 0. rows moved, both RMSEs and the squared change are reported.
